name: movement
purpose: Local WASD integration, blink mailbox and animation state.

name: keyboard
purpose: Typing mode and character queue; the native article accepts characters.

name: collision
purpose: Physical catch and pending victory on the original UI thread.

name: result_render
purpose: Overlay result keyboard hints after the original scene.

name: result_render_original
purpose: Continue the original all-scenes renderer.

name: render
purpose: Borrow a mod sprite for the current player, draw, then restore native fields.

name: sprite_origin
purpose: Keep enlarged shotgun W/SW cells aligned at the existing player blit.

name: render_original
purpose: Continue the original renderer after the detour.

name: device
purpose: Release owned surfaces and coordinate music on display changes.

name: device_original
purpose: Continue the original graphics callback.

name: overlay
purpose: Copy one coherent snapshot, draw bullet traces, flash and pixel HUD.

name: run_bank_0
purpose: Load the selected role/weapon running sheet (bank 0).

name: run_bank_1
purpose: Load the selected role/weapon running sheet (bank 1).

name: idle_bank
purpose: Load the selected role/weapon standing sheet.

name: network_poll
purpose: Send message 7 through the existing DirectPlay COM session.

name: network_receive
purpose: Copy bounded message 7 into the helper receive mailbox.

name: remote_movement
purpose: Apply authoritative remote poses on the native game thread.

name: copy_poses
purpose: Copy a stable pose mailbox using its even sequence number.

name: scene
purpose: Apply a requested existing native scene (lobby/play/win/loss).

name: remote_render
purpose: Draw the other player from the authoritative role/weapon pose.

name: remote_loader
purpose: Create a remote role/weapon surface with native ownership.

name: borrow_sprite
purpose: Temporarily substitute a sprite surface and descriptor.

name: restore_sprite
purpose: Restore every borrowed native sprite field.

name: release_remote
purpose: Release all owned remote surfaces.

name: ime
purpose: Capture/close/restore only the game window input context.

name: music
purpose: Mute the current native BGM buffer; restore volume and COM references.

name: caps_lock
purpose: Preserve the original caps-lock handling branch.

name: hud
purpose: Draw skills, persistent typing prompt/shared charge, hearts, weapon and ammo.

name: article_loop
purpose: Record accepted native article progress while movement owns the player.

name: character_original
purpose: Continue the original accepted-character handler.

name: typing_power
purpose: Measure the native article caret, draw pixel flames, shake the completed back buffer.

name: map_move
purpose: Resolve local/AI feet against the expanded city mask with subpixel axis sliding.

name: lan_address
purpose: Supply a directed broadcast BSTR to native DirectPlay connection initialization.
